hypothesis: V70/V71 source batch censoring left most Orion targets with no response evidence. Aggregate all eligible treated cells using matched per-batch control-rate/depth offsets before estimating response and uncertainty; do not require ten treated cells in each batch.
estimator: Control Gamma/quasi-Poisson moments per sample with >=20 NTCs. Expected treatment molecules E=sum_b library_exposure_b*control_proportion_b. Aggregate counts K across every matched treatment batch with >=1 cell, requiring >=40 total cells. Estimate overdispersion around depth*control_proportion_b*(K/E). Posterior log response digamma(0.5+K/Fano)-log(E/Fano), variance trigamma plus propagated control-rate variance. Gene support requires >=20 observed and expected molecules. Fano clipped 1..1000; own coordinates excluded. Working approximate count likelihood, not exact independent-cell NB inference.
selection: Same fixed first-three unique public cases/context; >=0.5% equal-study desired-profile error gain, no study >2% worse, better than cyclic label shuffle. Development is reused; lock before remaining cases. No failed-gate fallback.
confirmation: Same paired count evaluator and broader diagnostic as V70/V71. Production requires generated-profile, worst-study, shuffle and broad gates; report all other failures and unavailable values. No change of selected arm after confirmation.
scope: New estimator after failed V70/V71 development. Same public biology; no independent or hidden-test claim. D3 unopened.
